changelog:
trustpilot-reviews 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Trustpilot review scraper skill.
- Scrapes paginated customer reviews from any company page on trustpilot.com using a company domain and optional filters (page, star rating, language, verified-only, company reply, date range, keyword, reviewer country).
- Outputs 20+ structured fields per review, including reviewer info, ratings, dates, company replies, extended metadata, and review photos.
- Supports advanced usage for brand monitoring, competitor analysis, sentiment analysis training, fake review detection, and bulk export.
- Filters and pagination align with Trustpilot’s public website; no login or special access required.
summary: Trustpilot customer reviews scraper for any company listed on trustpilot.com — given a company domain (e.g. shopify.com, apple.com, shopwagandtail.com) plus optional filters (page number, single star rating 1-5, single language ISO code, verified-only flag, has-company-reply flag, date period last30
